141.news_title: Lots of Arcade CRT Monitors Tubes Available Soon
141.long_description:
With the release of our 4x3 LCD arcade monitors, we have received a number of requests from large chain operators wanting to sell out their CRT monitors once they upgrade to LCD.

We have also received feedback that owners who were keeping extra arcade CRT tubes and chassis to maintain their CRT arcade machines are also looking to clear their inventory as they plan to upgrade to the Arcooda monitor series. 

If you have interest to purchase CRT monitors, stay tuned as we can refer you directly to these owners.
